title: Log rows show the user, and date and time in your location's calendar
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Your user name is {User-A}.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S12 Admin.
  • You are enrolled at {Location-B}, in a time zone {Hours-A} hours apart from {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-B} is in Toronto and {Hours-A} is 2 (Edmonton to Toronto).
  • Net 50 is active.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 50" row.
  2. Click "Deactivate".
  3. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  4. Click "Audit Log".
  5. Close the log.
  6. Switch location to {Location-B}.
  7. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  8. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a green success toast shows.
  • Step 3: the menu opens.
  • Step 4: the newest row shows User {User-A} and the date and time of the change as clocks at {Location-A} read them.
  • Step 5: the log closes.
  • Step 6: the page reloads.
  • Step 7: the menu opens.
  • Step 8: the same row now shows the time {Hours-A} hours later (as clocks at {Location-B} read it), and the date changes too if the move crosses midnight.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S12-R4: “The User column shows the name of the user who made the change; Date and Time show when, on the calendar of the location the user is working in.”
  • S12-R6: “The log is organization-wide (one log for all locations), kept indefinitely, and cannot be edited or deleted by anyone.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "1 List and row menus" ("Credit Terms Log"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p1-14-credit-terms-log.png

The design's own words:

  • “Columns Event, User, Details, Date, Time, newest first; Details read "{name}: {rule}" or "Field: old → new", one change per line.”
